title: Cebu City Hall returns to Friday ops, scraps 4-day workweek
summary: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City government employees will return to reporting for work five days a week, including Fridays. This comes after Mayor Nestor Archival revoked the four-day workweek…

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City government employees will return to reporting for work five days a week, including Fridays. This comes after Mayor Nestor Archival revoked the four-day workweek arrangement following the completion of its pilot implementation. Archival signed an executive order revoking the previous executive order that introduced the compressed workweek in September […]...
